title: TopoNet research paper, code, and highway observations
description: Research software and manuscript for a simulation study of graph-attention Double-DQN cellular handover. This release also includes a privacy-filtered extract of 5,064 one-second dashboard observations from three iPhone 15 recordings made while travelling along the Prithvi Highway. The observations provide field context only; they were not used to train, tune, or evaluate the controller. The phone-number and raw OCR fields and original screen recordings are excluded. The route and cell-layout inputs, trained policy checkpoints, and complete simulation case-level results are not included, so the reported simulation study cannot be reproduced from this release alone.
